name: The Dark Secrets Of This School
source:
Ayaka Asuka arrives at Akademi High School following her mother's new job at Saikou Corp.

No sooner has she arrived than she crosses paths with a hot-tempered girl and a boy on her way to school. Ayaka quickly strikes up a friendship with them and sets out to investigate the mysterious secrets of the school...

[Translated from [url=https://alialibuilder.itch.io/the-dark-secrets-of-this-school-francais#google_vignette]Itch.io[/url]]
